Getting started with the PS5 Input System package

Details initial set up steps for working with the PS5 Input System package.

Install the package

To access the features of the PS5 Input System package, install the package using the following steps:

  1. Download the package .tgz file from the PlayStation 5 Package Downloads Unity Discussions page.
  2. Install the .tgz file using the steps in the Package Manager documentation.
    • The package will also install the Unity Input System package as a dependency.

Enable the Input System

You must enable the new input system to allow the PS5 Input System package to operate correctly. To do this, use the following steps:

  1. From the Unity menu, navigate to Edit > Project Settings > Player > Configuration.
  2. Set Active Input Handling to Input System Package (New) or Both.

Install the sample

It’s recommended to install the provided samples to explore the features available to you. For more information about the included sample, refer to Use the sample project.
